workbench_instructions: Workbook covers sentence/image/form/handwriting/multilingual classes only indirectly; treat those as frontier or non-direct-signal lanes.
frontier_observations: Web frontier scan adds explicit notes for structure heading-depth limits, managed DI form/KVP candidates, and chart/class/reading-order claims for PP-StructureV3/Marker; these are candidate lanes only.
ParseBench (paper + benchmark runtime) is now the primary parser-e2e closure lane for multi-column order, structure formatting, and downstream semantic claims.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Docling exposes a hierarchical, source-spanning document model with tables, images, and key-value structures plus structured spans, useful for structure and artifact lineage closure.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: use for structural fallback candidates; launch remains tied to local manifest gates.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Surya targets OCR, layout analysis, reading-order recovery, and table recognition across many languages; useful for scanned-table and structure gap lanes.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: frontier-only until table/reading-order/word-order fixtures close production gates.

web_frontier_scan.signal: GROBID provides publication-focused document segmentation with heading/section/figure/table/floating layout models and explicit mention of paragraph/section titles and structure labels; hierarchy depth is still imperfect and needs separate evaluation before semantic heading claims.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate-only until heading-depth and hierarchy-grade fixtures are closed.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Azure Document Intelligence exposes prebuilt general-document and key-value APIs with section text, selection marks, and tables; useful managed fallback only with consent/residency + uncertainty contract.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate lane only; keep managed KVP separate from native widget evidence until schema+review gates are in place.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Google Document AI layout + form parsers provide table/key-value extraction and image-quality/de-skew preprocessing, but deployment remains managed-provider governed with contract and residency requirements.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: managed candidate lane; do not route policy assertions until governance and provider-policy gates are closed.

web_frontier_scan.signal: PP-StructureV3 documentation lists layout and table recognition, formula support, and 25+ layout element classes including figure/chart/table with layout restoration and SER/RE style extraction in key-information workflows.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: strong frontier candidate; keep as gated profile (especially rotated, low-quality, and multi-column tables).

web_frontier_scan.signal: Marker reports OCR-if-needed flow using Surya plus conversion to markdown/JSON/HTML with tables, forms, equations, layout/reading-order behavior, so useful as a full-document lane candidate.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: frontier candidate only; no production routing until deterministic benchmark closure.

web_frontier_scan.capability_family: benchmark pressure (multifile, layout, tables, formulas, headings)
web_frontier_scan.signal: Paper benchmark defines multi-page parsing protocol with text, table, formula, figure extraction plus reading order and heading hierarchy grading.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: Use as hard stress benchmark source before claiming semantic structure/table/figure closure.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Paper describes challenging real-document parsing benchmarks focused on layout, reading order, hierarchical relations and block-level annotations across long documents.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: Use this benchmark profile for long-document and hierarchical-order closure planning.

web_frontier_scan.signal: RT-DocLayout claims end-to-end layout analysis with learned reading-order prediction, with emphasis on distorted/scanned documents and downstream table/math/image reconstruction compatibility.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: strong lane candidate for rotated/low-quality layout recovery; gate remains on rotated/multi-column/multi-script closure.

web_frontier_scan.signal: MDPBench defines multilingual real-world document parsing with language-aware reconstruction and extraction tracks, directly aligned to our gap on locale/Script quality.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: use as the first-class benchmark anchor before closing multilingual quality claims.

web_frontier_scan.finder: Zero-Shot Table Extraction in Business Documents (WACV 2026)
web_frontier_scan.signal: Defines a unified benchmark with error taxonomy for business-document table extraction, including merged-cell and irregular grid stress coverage.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate benchmarking lane; use before rotating table and multilingual table production claims.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Synthetic document-to-table benchmark with task-decomposed scoring and strong emphasis on structural reconstruction diagnostics.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate benchmarking lane for scanned-table and malformed-grid gate closure.

web_frontier_scan.signal: OCR benchmark covering degraded and historically messy records with handwriting and table-like document classes, useful for candidate-lane failure diagnostics.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate lane only; map handwritten and noisy-form cases before routing claims.

web_frontier_scan.signal: PulseBench-Tab is a multilingual table-extraction benchmark over 9 languages using T-LAG structural+content scoring, useful for language-aware table closure planning.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: candidate benchmarking lane only; add per-language table fixture gates before promotion.

web_frontier_scan.signal: Recent reading-order modeling research highlights order as a separately benchmarked failure mode, reinforcing dedicated adversarial fixtures for this class.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: use this as benchmark signal for ordering/rotation/multi-column ordering gates.

web_frontier_scan.signal: ParseBench publishes parser scoring on content faithfulness, reading-order correctness, semantic formatting, and structure hierarchy over noisy and multi-column pages.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: primary benchmark anchor for production readiness decisions on parser-derived structured outputs.

web_frontier_scan.capability_family: OCR realism and LMM OCR robustness pressure
web_frontier_scan.signal: OCRBench v2 tracks practical OCR robustness gaps in multilingual and noisy-document conditions and helps close model-level risk before production routing.
web_frontier_scan.status_note: use as a pressure test for frontier OCR/VLM routing and pre/post-deployment gating.
